newsitem.title: ITALY: PIRELLI LAUNCHES OFFER FOR PIRELLI TYRE NV.
newsitem.headline: PIRELLI LAUNCHES OFFER FOR PIRELLI TYRE NV.

text.p: Italian tyre and cable maker Pirelli SpA announced a public offer for all the outstanding shares and warrants it does not already own in Pirelli Tyre Holding NV listed on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange.
Pirelli SpA already holds 93.6 percent of the outstanding shares and 93.7 percent of the outstanding warrants of Pirelli Tyre Holding NV.
Pirelli SpA is expect to offer an amount of 19.50 guilders per share and 0.50 guilders per warrant in cash, a Pirelli statement said.

The statement said that the board of directors of Pirelli SpA and the board of management of Pirelli Tyre Holding NV reached agreement on the proposed public offer for all the shares held by third parties.
ABN AMRO Rothschild is acting as a financial advisor to Pirelli SpA in the offer.
The offer is based on Pirelli SpA's strategy to simplify the group's structure and to concentrate the share value of the two core business -- tyres and cables -- in Pirelli SpA, the statement said.
Pirelli Tyre Holding NV , the holding company of the Pirelli group tyre sector, made its initial public offering whereby 11 million shares were issued at a price of 54.00 guilders per share in 1989.
Two further rights issue were made in 1993 and 1994 respectively for 46.533 million share at 10 guilders per share and 31.022 million shares at a price of 17.10 guilders.

The condition of the offer will be stated in an information memorandum which is expected to be published within four weeks as soon as all formal approvals have been obtained, the Pirelli statement added.
After the offer has been honoured, termination of the listing of Pirelli Tyre Holding NV shares and warrants on the Amsterdam exchange will be sought, it added.
Earlier on Tuesday, shares in Pirelli Tyre Holding NV were suspended pending the announcement, the Amsterdam exchange announced.

In 1995, Pirelli Tyre posted a total net profit of 41.9 million guilders compared with a loss of 33.8 million in the previous year. In the first half of 1996, net profit surged to 55.4 million guilders compared with a profit of 10.7 million in the same period of 1995.
Pirelli Tyre said in September it expected a further improvement in the second half of 1996.
